trunks.title: Trunk routing rules
trunks.confirm_delete_rule_message: Deleting this rule will remove its routing configuration permanently
trunks.no_trunks_description: Start by adding a rule to route calls based on phone number prefix
trunks.configure_trunk_description: Create a new rule to route calls based on a number prefix (root)
trunks.root_helper: Enter the number prefix that triggers this rule
trunks.providers_are_missing_description: You must install and configure at least one NethVoice application on this node before you can create trunk routing rules.

settings.title: Settings
settings.fqdn_helper: FQDN of the instance. Must be a valid domain name
settings.address_helper: IPv4 address expected to receive VoIP traffic
settings.address_and_iface_dont_match_message: For the devices in the PBX local network to work correctly, the 'Hairpin NAT' feature — also known as 'NAT reflection', 'NAT hairpinning', 'NAT on a stick' or 'Loopback NAT' — must be enabled on the firewall (specifically, on the device that manages the NAT of the public IP).
settings.address_tooltip: This is required only if it differs from @:settings.interface address. The address is filled automatically based on the resolved FQDN above, but you can change it if needed.
settings.alerts_description: When enabled, the proxy checks its services and the SIP trunks it relays every 5 minutes and raises these alerts:
settings.alerts_service_down: a proxy service (Kamailio, rtpengine, PostgreSQL or Redis) is stopped or keeps restarting
settings.alerts_trunk_unreachable: a SIP trunk relayed by the proxy cannot reach its provider
settings.alerts_where: Active alerts are shown in the Nodes page and, if the cluster has a subscription, on my.nethesis.it.
settings.port_invalid: Must be a number between 1024 and 9999
settings.sip_port_in_use: Already used by another service on this address
settings.sip_port_reserved: Ports 6060 and 6061 are used by the local networks listeners
settings.sip_port_tooltip: UDP and TCP port for phones, gateways and trunks. Provisioned phones and gateways get the new port; trunk providers and manually configured devices must be updated by hand.
settings.sips_port_tooltip: TLS port for phones, gateways and the mobile app. Provisioned devices and the app get the new port; manually configured devices must be updated by hand.
settings.bypass_description: SIP traffic over UDP from these IP addresses skips the proxy and goes directly to the selected NethVoice instance. Use it for local gateways and trunks that do not work through the proxy.
settings.bypass_no_instances: No NethVoice instance on this node
settings.bypass_no_instances_description: The proxy bypass sends the traffic to a NethVoice instance that runs on the same node as the proxy.
settings.bypass_active_devices: Devices already connected to the proxy
settings.bypass_active_devices_description: A device that is already sending SIP traffic to the proxy keeps using it until it stays silent for about {minutes} minutes. To apply a change at once, stop the device for that time or restart the node.
settings.bypass_source_duplicated: This IP address is already in the list
settings.bypass_source_instance_not_found: The selected NethVoice instance is not on this node

error.root_already_exists: A rule with this root name already exists
